# [?] use patched version of vrf to fix security issue

## Summary
Severity: Unknown
Chain: Conflux
Component: Conflux-Chain/conflux-rust
Published: 2025-06-18
Source: https://github.com/Conflux-Chain/conflux-rust/commit/b3e67de45c663877ac9d1ac11b168fc68eea967d
Type: security-commit

## Details
use patched version of vrf to fix security issue

patch sqlite3-sys in tools

## Patch
### tools/consensus_bench/Cargo.lock
```diff
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@

 # It is not intended for manual editing.
-version = 3
+version = 4
 
 [[package]]
 name = "accumulator"
@@ -2559,28 +2559,6 @@ dependencies = [
  "rand 0.8.5",
 ]
```

### tools/consensus_bench/Cargo.toml
```diff
@@ -15,3 +15,8 @@ threadpool = "1.7"
 parking_lot = "0.12"
 log4rs = { version = "1.3.0", features = ["background_rotation", "gzip"] }
 log = "0.4"
+
+[patch.crates-io]
+# use a forked version to fix a vulnerability(introduced by failure) in vrf-rs, can be removed after the upstream is fixed
+vrf = { git = "https://github.com/andrcmdr/vrf-rs.git", rev = "f7bdb21f7f5d1858a3bb0183f194440f9a4199b3" }
+sqlite3-sys = { git = "https://github.com/Conflux-Chain/sqlite3-sys.git", rev = "1de8e5998f7c2d919336660b8ef4e8f52ac43844" }
```
